meaning:
ἐνυπνιάζω
(ἐνύπνιον), [in LXX, as in NT, -ομαι, depon., chiefly for חָלַם ;]
to dream: ἐνυπνίοις ἐ., Act.2:17 (LXX); present ptcp., Ju 8.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: ‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see…
Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.
